newRuntime.ghostPreview: GhostPreviewDTO stored in owner-local Vault buffer 70370; PlayerBuilder active preview is data-only for ModuleTemplate buildables and no longer spawns activeBuildable.ghostPrefab or acquires a runtime proxy shell
newRuntime.csr: Owner-local direction CSR buffers 70371 and 70372 bucket open finite target sockets by direction, excluding Connected, CollisionBlocked, non-finite, and invalid-direction rows before fill; PackAllowedConnectionBitmask does not wrap invalid authored directions; ghost rows preserve source SocketDefinitions indices and map to inverse-direction ranges; invalid ghost rows are NonFinite|CollisionBlocked with zero CSR range; missing CSR range/index lanes set CapacityExceeded instead of falling back to 0..TargetCount or direct csrIndex rows; invalid CSR target rows consume budget and mark NonFinite instead of aborting the bucket
newRuntime.matching: EvaluateSocketSnappingJob deterministic Burst; inspected target-row budget is continuous quality-gated before radius/compatibility/alignment rejection, target rows resolve through CSR indirection, pending/cached poses require Vault topology hash plus ghost query hash with ResolveShinobuModuleHash TemplateHashId fallback, stale cached snap poses are invalidated before DearLieActive can persist across query changes, SelectBestSocketSnapJob uses a single writable Results handle with a reserved sink row plus finite-result gate, active alignment scheduling is exposed through TryUpdateShinobuSocketAlignment, topology hash no longer samples runtime transforms or GameObject identity because AUP Vault rows are authority, and final snap application rejects invalid target/ghost directions before pose mutation
newRuntime.activeSnapVaultSource: Active SHINOBU snap reads pre-published ConstructionSocketModules/SocketStateDTO/SocketAup counters and connection pairs from Vault, then prepares only the CSR/hash cache. It no longer pulls ConstructionManager.SpawnedModules, ModuleMarker components, GetInstanceID(), or transforms to hydrate target socket rows; if the construction owner has not published target rows, snap fails closed instead of scene-scanning. Construction occupied-cell validation also reads finite ConstructionSocketModuleDTO.RootAup rows from the same Vault view instead of hydrating ConstructionBuilderOccupancy from scene modules.
newRuntime.occupancy: Active SHINOBU placement appends placed-module socket rows directly to Vault from the placement command pose, marks the target and consumed ghost sockets Connected, writes one SocketConnectionPairDTO into ConstructionSocketConnections, updates Counters[4], and invalidates cached topology if the commit fails closed. The legacy ModuleSocket.SetOccupied branch is removed. PlayerBuilder no longer locks or writes ConstructionBuilderOccupancy for active occupied-cell checking; grid rejection compares request.GridPos against Vault module RootAup rows. Burst skips Connected rows; compatibility uses AreCompatibilityHashesCompatible(); HashCompatibility reserves 0 for wildcard by remapping non-empty folded zero to 1
newRuntime.rootAup: Construction validation root authority reads ConstructionSocketModuleDTO.RootAup from the SHINOBU Vault module lane through TryUpdateConstructionRootAupFromSocketVault before falling back to the current preview position; occupied-cell checking uses the same module RootAup lane. The old scene-scanning ResolveConstructionRootAup helper was removed
newRuntime.adaptation: AdaptConnectedSocketsJob writes corridor, hatch, and connected flags
newRuntime.visual: ConstructionPreviewSignal carries DearLieDampen, GlobalQualityWeight, and DearLieWiggleSpeed at aligned offsets 96/100/104; HectonBlueprintPreviewBatch applies a continuous decaying material envelope, derives BuilderGhostVisualDTO alpha, telemetry SDF sign, and _lastPreviewAllowed from current written validation flags instead of previous-frame _lastPreviewAllowed or pre-sanitized signal flags, requires all scale axes to be positive before preserving valid flags, and resets the envelope when preview count reaches zero; Hecton8/Fabrication/BlueprintWireInstanced and Hecton8/Construction/DearLieHologram both apply scalar dampening and vertex sine wiggle; ModuleTemplate previews use builder pose/scale fields plus Vault GhostPreviewDTO rather than ghostPrefab pool spawn or runtime proxy shell acquisition; cold fallback proxy materials initialize _H8SnapDampen to 0 until a snap signal drives the fake
newRuntime.builderGhostValidation: BuildBuilderGhostStateJob schedules before ValidateBuilderGhostPlacementJob; ValidateBuilderGhostPlacementJob writes final BuilderGhostStateDTO flags and mirrors those flags plus alpha into BuilderGhostVisualDTO; PlayerBuilder registers the final construction handle and active preview ticks consume the BuilderGhostStateDTO only through DispatcherJobFence.TryFinalizeCompleted. Pending validation ownership is guarded by the active buildable generation plus a query hash over module hash, preview pose/rotation, proxy bounds center/size, and snap/DearLie flags. Active validation uses the pure TryResolveShinobuSocketVault/TryResolveVaultViews read gates after BindRuntimeReferences cold-initializes Vault handles, and it does not fall back to GlobalRegistry.DataVault. HectonBlueprintPreviewBatch binds builder-holography VaultGenerationHandle descriptors in Awake/OnEnable through EnsureBuffersCold and active ticks only call TryReadCachedBuffers. Builder holography SDF placement proof always hydrates and evaluates all eight deterministic bounds corners; terrain placement truth uses fixed TerrainProbeTruthCount=9; GlobalQualityWeight scales shader/material presentation and snap candidate/search budgets through SmoothQuality + math.lerp only, not placement truth. DispatcherJobFence.TryComplete remains only on lifecycle teardown helpers.
newRuntime.builderHolographyGenerationHandles: HectonBlueprintPreviewBatch stores VaultGenerationHandle<T> descriptors for builder ghost state, visual, telemetry, and indirect-args lanes. EnsureBuffersCold acquires them with GetGenerationHandle and active TryReadCachedBuffers resolves phase-local NativeArray views with IDataVault.TryResolveHandle, with no VaultBufferHandle<T>, ResolveBuffer, GetBufferHandle, or .Resolve(vault) residue in the batch.
newRuntime.validatorDeterminism: BurstGridValidationJob, LogisticsGraphSpliceJob, DeconstructionConnectivityJob, and HabitatConstructionManager.IntegrityValidationJob use FloatMode.Deterministic because they feed placement validity, graph splice, connectivity truth, and structural support truth.
newRuntime.telemetry: Active snap path writes 300 entry ConstructionSocketTelemetryEntry ring with Dump_SHINOBU_217.bin non-finite dump; builder holography writes HolographyTelemetryEntry and dumps to Dump_SHINOBU_217_Holography.bin; construction validation writes ConstructionTelemetryEntry and dumps to Dump_SHINOBU_217_ConstructionValidation.bin, not a foreign agent path. These dump APIs write ReadOnlySpan<byte> over NativeArray pointers to FileStream instead of allocating managed mirror byte arrays. Reducer sink aggregates EvaluatedCandidates and NonFinite/CollisionBlocked/CapacityExceeded flags from all ghost rows; optional telemetry job reads clamped BestResultIndex for the reserved reducer sink row; ConstructionPreviewSignal, construction validation payloads, acoustic source fallback, and FloraExclusionSignal module identity use ResolveShinobuModuleHash fallback
newRuntime.frameAuthority: PlayerBuilder and HectonBlueprintPreviewBatch no longer stamp SHINOBU-owned preview, validation, deconstruction, flora, or holography rows with Unity Time.frameCount or Time.unscaledTime. They capture TimeSliceScheduler.CurrentFrameId and fall back only to an owner-local monotonic counter when dispatcher frame identity is zero; Dear Lie animation phase is derived from frame/120 instead of wall-clock time. Static scan over both files has zero Time.frameCount, Time.unscaledTime, and Time.time hits.
newRuntime.runtimeOriginSignalBridgeRemoval: PlayerBuilder, HectonBlueprintPreviewBatch, and HabitatConstructionManager no longer call GlobalSignals.CurrentRuntimeOriginAup in SHINOBU snap, holography, or habitat socket AUP conversion. Local finite-guarded helpers read HectonFloatingOrigin.CurrentTotalOffsetDouble as double3, pass that origin into snap/holography jobs, add it before authored socket AUP hydration, and subtract it in double precision before runtime Vector3 casts.
newRuntime.semanticPlacementRules: IBuildPlacementRule.cs was deleted. PlayerBuilder caches semantic rule kind as a byte tag and dispatches to sealed DeepDrillModule.ValidatePlacementWithService() or AutonomousExtractorModule.ValidatePlacementWithRuntime(). Deep-drill validation consumes a cached IInteractionSignalService runtime raycast route with finite runtime coordinates and no InteractionPacket or Unity Time stamp; CacheActivePlacementRule no longer has a GlobalRegistry.InteractionSignals fallback. Extractor validation consumes the cached AutonomousExtractorSystem or fails closed, and resource-node candidate distance requires persistent AUP instead of transform fallback.
newRuntime.mockGridCounterScrub: GenerateMockBaseConstructionGrid clears every ConstructionSocketCounters lane before writing module count, socket count, topology version, and flags. This makes Counters[4] connection-pair count zero for the mock grid instead of leaving stale UninitializedMemory data visible to topology hashing and placement commit checks.
newRuntime.coldCounterLaneSeedGuard: InitializeVault checks the existing ConstructionSocketCounters generation handle before requesting the lane. Absent, too-short, or out-of-capacity counters are cleared once after handle resolution; valid existing counters are preserved. TryResolveVaultViews remains resolve-only and does not mutate active state.
newRuntime.activeSelectionFencing: CycleBuildable and DebugDeployActiveBuildable no longer call BindRuntimeReferences. SetActiveBuildable no longer force-completes pending SHINOBU socket snap or builder ghost validation jobs; active selection and post-placement preview refresh use DespawnGhost(forceValidationReset:false). Pending socket snap and builder ghost validation jobs store the active buildable generation at schedule time, cached snap reuse checks the generation, and stale completed results are discarded after natural DispatcherJobFence.TryFinalizeCompleted instead of blocking active input.
newRuntime.buildCostBufferFence: HabitatConstructionManager build-cost validation now uses fixed cold scratch buffers: PlayerInventory.ItemPlacement[1024] and cost hash/remaining/removed/item buffers sized to 32 rows. Active HasBuildResources and ConsumeBuildResources fail closed when authored costs or inventory grid size exceed those fixed capacities instead of growing managed arrays or truncating resource evidence.
newRuntime.integrityGraphCacheSignature: HabitatConstructionManager now computes its existing integrity graph cache signature from SHINOBU socket Vault topology when Vault module count matches the construction registry count. The signature folds ConstructionSocketModuleDTO AUP/rotation/socket/topology fields plus SocketConnectionPairDTO connection rows. The absent/count-mismatched Vault fallback hashes ModuleHashId, family, AUP-quantized root, and rotation bits instead of Unity GetInstanceID because support-root/family and resource-mass facts are not yet present in socket DTOs.
newRuntime.continuousSnapQualityMath: ShinobuSocketConstructionRuntime.ResolveCandidateBudget and ResolveSearchRadius now consume GlobalQualityWeight through SmoothQuality plus math.lerp. EvaluateSocketSnappingJob clamps inspected CSR target rows to the resolved min-to-max candidate budget and uses the resolved low-to-ultra search radius instead of always taking the max budget and ultra radius.
newRuntime.integrityAdjacencyCorruptionFence: HabitatConstructionManager.BuildAdjacency validates every connection endpoint before adjacency degree counting and final adjacency writes, checks AdjacencyRanges creation/length before mutation, fences connection count against both buffer length and _connectionCapacity, and rejects adjacency-count overflow by invalidating the graph cache. AddConnection rejects negative endpoints and self-loops before writing a connection row.
newRuntime.tunerReadPurity: ModularBaseConstructionValidator.TryReadTunerSettingsFromVault is now strict: missing or invalid Vault data returns false with a default out value. PlayerBuilder explicitly falls back to GetTunerSettings when the Vault read fails, so the caller owns fallback provenance instead of the read facade hiding static state.
newRuntime.validatorGenerationDescriptors: ModularBaseConstructionValidator tuning, telemetry, bounds, and occupancy lanes now store VaultGenerationHandle<T> descriptors. Ensure/write routes acquire with GetGenerationHandle, read routes resolve with IDataVault.TryResolveHandle, and the file has no VaultBufferHandle, GetBufferHandle, ResolveBuffer, .Resolve(vault), or TryGetBuffer residue.
newRuntime.surfaceHitOwnership: PlayerBuilder.TryGetBuildHit no longer calls UnityEngine.Physics.RaycastNonAlloc and no longer owns a RaycastHit buffer. Preview and deconstruction target queries consume the cold-cached IInteractionSignalService.TryRaycastPrimary runtime-position overload with finite guards and a stable builder requester id; missing interaction service fails closed.
newRuntime.builderDeconstructionTargetRegistry: PlayerBuilder no longer calls GetComponentInParent<BaseModule>() after interaction-owned hits. TryDeconstructTargetModule and GetTargetedModule resolve hit colliders through LaserCutterTargetRegistry.TryResolveModule, which BaseModule.OnEnable populates for module collider trees. Missing registry rows fail closed without scene hierarchy fallback.
newRuntime.extractorRuntimeRegistry: AutonomousExtractorSystem now uses a fixed AutonomousExtractorModule[256] registry plus _moduleCount instead of a growable List. DeepDrillModule now uses fixed DeepDrillModule[128] active-provider storage plus s_ActiveModuleCount instead of a static growable List. ExtractorJobInput/ExtractorJobResult are explicit 32-byte rows, AdvanceExtractionJob uses CompileSynchronously=true, FloatMode.Deterministic, FloatPrecision.Standard with NoAlias input/result lanes, and the unreferenced AutonomousExtractorJobs.cs duplicate was deleted. The remaining extractor semantic PhysX overlap is fenced as a world-resource contract gap because Hecton8.World.Contracts exposes ore position/type read lanes but not extractor support, host diameter, yield item hash, depletion, or stable claim identity.
